meta.name: ScopeDiff Design Standard
meta.description: Project copy of the personal design standard. Authoritative for ScopeDiff. Chosen variant: neobrutalism with minimalism restraint.
howToUse: Read this file before any UI, branding, marketing or admin-console work.
Use the tokens in web/src/styles/tokens.css; do not introduce a second accent or a new style variant.
Both light and dark themes are required for every component.
Status colors communicate state only; they are never brand accents.

project.name: ScopeDiff
project.tagline: Know what changed before you test.
project.audience: Bug bounty hunters who triage scope changes before spending time on a target
project.tone: Technical, direct, calm under pressure, never hypey
project.variantNotes: Neobrutalist structure (2px borders, hard offset shadows, blocky controls) held back with minimalist spacing, a single amber accent and a tight type scale. Amber is reserved for primary actions, active filters and materiality. Nothing else competes.

principles: The diff is the product: hierarchy must make added, removed and changed obvious before any prose.
One accent: amber marks the action or the score, never both at once.
Structure over decoration: borders and offset shadows define clickable regions.
Published facts only: no invented confidence, no scanning language, no exploitation cues.
Accessible by default: AA contrast, 44px touch targets, visible focus, meaning never by color alone.
Motion confirms cause and effect, especially the simulation and the toast.

button.primary: amber background, accent-ink text, 2px border, hard shadow
button.secondary: surface background, strong border, hard shadow
button.ghost: transparent fill, soft border, no strong shadow
button.danger: red text and border, red-soft fill

chips.usage: kind, platform, impact, confidence, scope and alert status
chips.rule: always include a text label; icon alone is never the meaning

materiality.usage: one weighted score out of 100 per change and per target
materiality.bar: 6px track with amber fill; score always visible in text

toast.rule: announce with role=status; errors use role=alert

rules: The mobile filter toggle exposes aria-expanded.
The toast is a live region and errors are assertive.
Reduced motion is respected by the global media query.

usageRules: Use web/src/styles/tokens.css and globals.css. Do not add a second accent.
Amber is for primary actions, active filter state and materiality; status colors are for state only.
Keep borders at 2px and shadows hard and offset; never soften the core cards into generic SaaS shadows.
Demo content must stay fictional and use RFC 2606 domains and RFC 5737 ranges.
Marketing copy must never imply scanning, exploitation or unauthorized testing.
New screens need light and dark verification plus a 390px mobile pass.
